acceptance_checks.check_id: ArtifactCas uses exactly the deterministic digest-derived layout root/sha256/xx/64hex, rejects invalid root/entry types within the bounded API, never accepts caller-controlled blob-relative path components, and exposes no public mutable-final-path primitive.
acceptance_checks.detail: CAS core and adversarial coverage prove root/sha256/xx/64hex digest-derived paths, invalid/non-regular root and entry rejection, Unix symlink-root rejection, and absence of a public caller-controlled final-path primitive.

acceptance_checks.check_id: Binding CAS content to Artifact metadata requires exact expected revision, preserves existing media_type and retention_ref, writes the verified digest/size through existing invariants only after blob publication, never creates metadata referring to absent/unverified bytes, and leaves any immutable orphan blob untouched if metadata CAS fails.
acceptance_checks.detail: Binding re-verifies the published CAS blob before any SQLite mutation, requires exact expected revision, preserves current media_type and retention_ref, reuses existing digest/size invariants, and stale/digest conflicts leave the immutable blob intact.

acceptance_checks.detail: Dependency-only PR #122 admitted exact sha2 0.11.0 with defaults disabled and no optional features before CAS code. Validation passed, the lock graph added no external package/version/source identity, and post-merge qualification completed before PR #123 began.

acceptance_checks.detail: Dependency, CAS core, binding/adversarial, and pre-proof closeout candidates passed bounded local checks including R3 and OpenCodeReview accounting, exact-head six-job CI/review with zero blocking threads, and every completed dependent implementation merge passed exact six-job post-merge qualification before dependent work began.

acceptance_checks.check_id: Every ingest API requires an explicit maximum size, streams through a bounded fixed buffer, accepts valid empty content, rejects over-limit input without final publication, computes exact SHA-256 and size, and rejects supplied expected-digest mismatch before publication.
acceptance_checks.detail: Ingest uses an explicit bounded size, fixed 64 KiB buffer, valid empty content, multi-chunk boundary coverage, incremental SHA-256, over-limit rejection, and expected-digest rejection before publication.

acceptance_checks.check_id: Final publication is no-overwrite and fail-closed: temporary bytes are synced before publication; an existing final path is never replaced; identical existing content verifies and succeeds without revealing dedup status; corrupt/mismatched/non-regular existing content fails; ordinary failure/success removes the current temp name.
acceptance_checks.detail: Temporary bytes are flushed and sync_all completes before hard-link publication. Existing final content is never replaced; identical content is reverified, corrupt/non-regular content fails, and ordinary success/failure temp cleanup is covered.

acceptance_checks.check_id: Local macOS, Ubuntu Rust CI, and native Windows kernux-store CI execute the CAS corpus successfully. Native Windows runtime evidence is required; cross-compilation is not a substitute.
acceptance_checks.detail: The final corpus passes 65/65 locally on macOS and in Ubuntu Rust CI. Native windows-latest passes 64/64; the one-test count difference is the intentionally Unix-only symbolic-link-root fixture, not missing Windows CAS coverage.

acceptance_checks.check_id: Multiple logical Artifact IDs may reference one identical content digest without merging logical identity, revision, metadata, retention_ref, provenance, or authority. CAS code does not evaluate retention policy and provides no final blob deletion/GC API.
acceptance_checks.detail: Executable coverage binds two distinct Artifact IDs to one identical digest while retaining independent revisions, media types and retention references. CAS exposes no retention evaluator or final blob deletion/GC API.

acceptance_checks.detail: open_verified enforces an explicit bound, requires a regular final entry, hashes the complete same read-only file handle, compares the requested digest, rewinds it, and rejects missing, oversized, tampered and truncated content with generic typed errors.
